column1: # Headroom canary ceilings for linked images. Fires BELOW the hard region
# size so the last few KB are spent deliberately, not discovered by a link
# failure on someone else's PR. Enforced by scripts/checks/check_image_headroom.py.
# Occupancy is the region high-water mark (highest section end minus base),
# which is what the linker's own Used Size reports, padding included.
# kind=load  flash/MRAM: LOAD sections, placed by LMA.
# kind=ram   RAM: every ALLOC section, placed by VMA, .bss included.
# Re-pin in the same PR that grows the image, and say why in the PR body.
